validity.researcher_notes: The project is real. ENTSOG's 2020 plan lists it as TRA-N-502, a 30 km, 700 mm pipe near Khotyn, tied to the Romanian project TRA-N-596 under one EU project code. Length, diameter, location and pre-final-investment-decision stage all match the sheet. Capacity is given only in energy units. The 40 million euro cost has no source. The Transgaz plan for 2026 to 2035 (shareholders approved July 2026) lists the Romanian Gheraesti to Siret link again, 130 km, 450 million euros, target 2032. No Ukrainian document confirms the Ukrainian part is cancelled or revived. Not a duplicate of any other roster row.

fills.researcher_notes: The ENTSOG ten-year plan from 2020 lists this as a gas transmission project between the Ukrainian and Romanian gas systems. I read the PDF text directly.

fills.researcher_notes: ENTSOG gives 700 mm for the Ukrainian part. That is about 27.56 inches, so the sheet's 27.60 is within rounding. The source states the figure in millimeters, so a person may prefer 700 mm.

verifications.note: ENTSOG TYNDP 2020 Annex A, page 262 to 264, project TRA-N-502 'Interconnector Romania - Ukraine', host country Ukraine

fills.researcher_notes: ENTSOG states capacity in energy terms: 87.10 GWh per day from Ukraine to Romania and 58.10 GWh per day the other way, both for 2025. At about 11 kWh per cubic meter, 87.10 GWh is near 7.9 million cubic meters a day. That is close to the sheet's 7.70 but the match depends on a heating value assumption.

fills.researcher_notes: ENTSOG gave 2025 as the expected commissioning year in a plan filed in June 2020. This is a stale target. The Romanian plan for 2026 to 2035 now targets 2032 for the Romanian side.

verifications.note: ENTSOG TYNDP 2020 Annex A, page 262 to 264, project TRA-N-502 'Interconnector Romania - Ukraine', host country Ukraine
Transgaz plan 2026-2035 section 7.7, phase 'Actualizare SPF', listed 'LA non FID'

fills.researcher_notes: ENTSOG marks the project Non-FID in 2020. The Transgaz plan for 2026 to 2035 still lists the Romanian side as not yet at a final investment decision. Both documents come from the project sponsors.

verifications.note: ENTSOG TYNDP 2020 Annex A, page 262 to 264, project TRA-N-502 'Interconnector Romania - Ukraine', host country Ukraine
section 7.7 names Siret as the border point

fills.researcher_notes: ENTSOG names the entry point 'Siret (RO) / Khotyn (UA)' and describes building a new pipeline in the Khotyn region. The Transgaz plan names Siret on the Romanian side. The region names on the sheet are general geography and are not stated in either document.

No source states 40 million euros for the Ukrainian part. The ENTSOG entry has no cost. The Transgaz plan for 2026 to 2035 prices the Romanian side at 450 million euros, which is a different pipe. The Ukrainian operator's own plan site returns a firewall block, and I did not find a readable copy that prices this part.

No source I found states that the Ukrainian part was cancelled. The Transgaz plan for 2026 to 2035 lists the Romanian side again as an active project for 2032, which points the other way. I found no dated Ukrainian operator document on this part. See the status review.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The Transgaz plan for 2026 to 2035 lists the Romanian side of this link again, in the updated pre-feasibility phase, target 2032. That is dated July 2026 but covers the Romanian section only. I found no dated Ukrainian operator or regulator source on the Ukrainian section, and the operator site is blocked from this machine. A search in Ukrainian found only general regulator talk of more capacity at the Romanian border. No status change is staged. Please check with the Ukrainian operator.
